# Demo summarizer

Read the target file and produce a three-line summary.

This fixture is deliberately inert and public-safe: it exists so the
agent-tooling profile has a real directory-shaped subject with stable bytes.
Note that this prose file is PART of the subject identity — a skill's docs are
model-readable behavior, so editing this sentence changes the bundle digest.
